CustomField.description: Day the weekly Analytics email goes out, as a CRON day-of-week abbreviation (MON/TUE/WED/THU/FRI/SAT/SUN). A Custom Setting field can't be a Picklist -- GtmAnalyticsSettingsController.saveSettings validates this against that fixed set before it's ever used to build a CRON expression.
CustomField.label: Digest Day Of Week
